examples.text_en: The commonwealth is made of many small countries.
examples.text_zh: 这个联邦由许多小国组成。

examples.text_en: These states formed a commonwealth long ago.
examples.text_zh: 这些州很久以前组成了一个联邦。

examples.text_en: A loud commotion came from the next room.
examples.text_zh: 隔壁房间传来一阵骚动。

examples.text_en: The commotion in the street woke everyone.
examples.text_zh: 街上的骚动吵醒了所有人。

examples.text_en: They share a communal garden behind the house.
examples.text_zh: 他们在屋后共用一座花园。

examples.text_en: The village has a communal water supply.
examples.text_zh: 这个村子有公共供水。

examples.text_en: They set up a small commune in the country.
examples.text_zh: 他们在乡下建立了一个小公社。

examples.text_en: Life in the commune was simple and hard.
examples.text_zh: 公社里的生活简单而艰苦。

examples.text_en: The commuter takes the same train every morning.
examples.text_zh: 这位上班族每天早上都坐同一趟火车。

examples.text_en: A tired commuter slept on the way home.
examples.text_zh: 一位疲惫的通勤者在回家的路上睡着了。

examples.text_en: The compaction of the soil took several hours.
examples.text_zh: 土壤的压实花了几个小时。

examples.text_en: Good compaction makes the road last longer.
examples.text_zh: 良好的压实能让道路更耐久。

examples.text_en: These two books are comparable in size and price.
examples.text_zh: 这两本书在大小和价格上不相上下。

examples.text_en: No other city is comparable to this one.
examples.text_zh: 没有别的城市能跟这一座相比。

examples.text_en: This book is comparatively short and easy.
examples.text_zh: 这本书相对简短易读。

examples.text_en: The winter here is comparatively mild.
examples.text_zh: 这里的冬天相对温和。

examples.text_en: She showed great compassion for the poor family.
examples.text_zh: 她对那个贫穷的家庭表现出极大的同情。

examples.text_en: His compassion moved everyone in the room.
examples.text_zh: 他的同情心感动了屋里的每个人。

examples.text_en: The compassionate woman gave the child her own food.
examples.text_zh: 这位富有同情心的女子把自己的食物给了那个孩子。

examples.text_en: A compassionate word can help a person a lot.
examples.text_zh: 一句体贴的话能给人很大帮助。

examples.text_en: These two systems are compatible and work well together.
examples.text_zh: 这两个系统彼此兼容，配合良好。

examples.text_en: Their views are not compatible on this point.
examples.text_zh: 在这一点上他们的看法不相容。

examples.text_en: She gave a compelling reason to change the plan.
examples.text_zh: 她给出了一个令人信服的理由来改变计划。

examples.text_en: The story was so compelling that we read all night.
examples.text_zh: 这个故事太引人入胜了，我们读了一整夜。

examples.text_en: The book is a compendium of useful facts.
examples.text_zh: 这本书是一本实用知识的汇编。

examples.text_en: He wrote a compendium of local plant names.
examples.text_zh: 他编写了一部当地植物名称的纲要。

examples.text_en: The company paid him compensation for the loss.
examples.text_zh: 公司为这次损失向他支付了赔偿金。

examples.text_en: He asked for compensation after the bad fall.
examples.text_zh: 那次重重的摔倒之后，他要求得到补偿。

examples.text_en: The court gave her a compensatory payment.
examples.text_zh: 法庭判给她一笔补偿金。

examples.text_en: These compensatory days off help tired workers.
examples.text_zh: 这些补休日对疲惫的工人有帮助。

examples.text_en: Her competence at work earned the trust of all.
examples.text_zh: 她的工作能力赢得了所有人的信任。

examples.text_en: The job calls for real competence and care.
examples.text_zh: 这份工作需要真正的能力和细心。

examples.text_en: The two competing teams share one small room.
examples.text_zh: 两支相互竞争的队伍共用一个小房间。

examples.text_en: We heard competing views about the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 我们听到了关于新计划的相互矛盾的观点。

examples.text_en: The competitiveness of the market grew over the years.
examples.text_zh: 这些年来市场的竞争性不断增强。

examples.text_en: Hard work can improve the competitiveness of a team.
examples.text_zh: 努力可以提高一支队伍的竞争力。

examples.text_en: Complacence about safety can cause serious accidents.
examples.text_zh: 对安全的自满可能导致严重的事故。

examples.text_en: His complacence vanished after the first test.
examples.text_zh: 第一次测试后，他的自满便消失了。

examples.text_en: Complacency can lead a team to lose the game.
examples.text_zh: 自满会让一支队伍输掉比赛。

examples.text_en: After the first win, complacency set in.
examples.text_zh: 第一次获胜之后，自满情绪就产生了。

examples.text_en: The team grew complacent after the easy win.
examples.text_zh: 轻松取胜后，这支队伍变得自满起来。

examples.text_en: Never become complacent about your daily work.
examples.text_zh: 永远不要对自己的日常工作感到自满。

examples.text_en: She showed complaisance to every wish of the group.
examples.text_zh: 她对小组的每个意愿都表现得顺从。

examples.text_en: His complaisance made him agree to everything.
examples.text_zh: 他的殷勤顺从使他什么都答应。

examples.text_en: The complaisant man agreed to every plan.
examples.text_zh: 这个殷勤顺从的人对每个计划都表示同意。

examples.text_en: She was too complaisant to say no to them.
examples.text_zh: 她太顺从了，无法对他们说不。

examples.text_en: The two skills are complementary and work well together.
examples.text_zh: 这两项技能互为补充，配合良好。

examples.text_en: Blue and gold are complementary colors on this wall.
examples.text_zh: 蓝色和金色是这面墙上的互补色。

examples.text_en: The sun gave her face a warm complexion.
examples.text_zh: 阳光使她的脸有了温暖的气色。

examples.text_en: His complexion turned white after the long night.
examples.text_zh: 经过漫长的一夜，他的脸色变得苍白。

examples.text_en: The company was in full compliance with the law.
examples.text_zh: 这家公司完全遵从法律。

examples.text_en: His compliance with the rules made the work easy.
examples.text_zh: 他遵从规则，使工作变得轻松。

examples.text_en: Extra rules will complicate a simple task.
examples.text_zh: 额外的规定会把简单的任务弄复杂。

examples.text_en: Bad weather can complicate the travel plans.
examples.text_zh: 恶劣的天气会让旅行计划变得复杂。

examples.text_en: A small complication made the plan fall apart.
examples.text_zh: 一个小问题使计划泡汤了。

examples.text_en: The doctor said there was one more complication.
examples.text_zh: 医生说还有一处并发症。

examples.text_en: The police found evidence of his complicity.
examples.text_zh: 警方发现了他是同谋的证据。

examples.text_en: Her complicity in the act was never proven.
examples.text_zh: 她参与此事的同谋关系始终没有得到证实。

examples.text_en: The manager gave us a complimentary cup of coffee.
examples.text_zh: 经理请我们喝了一杯免费的咖啡。

examples.text_en: He wrote a complimentary note about her new book.
examples.text_zh: 他为她的新书写了一句称赞的话。

examples.text_en: The two parts compose a simple tune.
examples.text_zh: 这两个部分组成了一支简单的曲子。

examples.text_en: She will compose a song for the school.
examples.text_zh: 她将为学校创作一首歌。

examples.text_en: The table is made of a composite material.
examples.text_zh: 这张桌子由一种合成材料制成。

examples.text_en: A composite image showed the entire city.
examples.text_zh: 一张合成图像展示了整座城市。

examples.text_en: They added kitchen waste to the compost pile.
examples.text_zh: 他们把厨余垃圾倒进堆肥堆里。

examples.text_en: Good compost helps the garden plants grow.
examples.text_zh: 好的堆肥有助于花园里的植物生长。

examples.text_en: The report gives a comprehensive view of the plan.
examples.text_zh: 这份报告全面介绍了这个计划。

examples.text_en: She wrote a comprehensive guide for new students.
examples.text_zh: 她为新生写了一份全面的指南。

examples.text_en: They compress the air into a small tank.
examples.text_zh: 他们把空气压进一个小罐子里。

examples.text_en: This tool can compress a large pile of clothes.
examples.text_zh: 这个工具能把一大摞衣服压实。

examples.text_en: The air in the box is compressed and cold.
examples.text_zh: 箱子里的空气被压缩过，而且很冷。

examples.text_en: They sent the goods in a compressed form.
examples.text_zh: 他们以压缩的形式寄出了这些货物。

examples.text_en: The compression of the file saved much space.
examples.text_zh: 文件的压缩节省了大量空间。

examples.text_en: Good compression keeps the image clear and small.
examples.text_zh: 良好的压缩能让图像既清晰又小巧。

examples.text_en: He felt a strange compulsion to check the door.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种奇怪的冲动要去检查门。

examples.text_en: The compulsion to work late tired her.
examples.text_zh: 加班的强迫感让她疲惫。

examples.text_en: He had a compulsive need to check the door.
examples.text_zh: 他有一种强迫性的需要，总要去检查门。

examples.text_en: Her compulsive care for the house never stops.
examples.text_zh: 她对房子的强迫性操心从不停止。

examples.text_en: He felt no compunction about what he did.
examples.text_zh: 他对自己所做的事毫无悔意。

examples.text_en: She showed compunction and said she was sorry.
examples.text_zh: 她表现出悔意，说了声抱歉。

examples.text_en: The computation of the cost took a long time.
examples.text_zh: 成本的计算花了很长时间。

examples.text_en: A quick computation gave us the right answer.
examples.text_zh: 一次快速的计算给了我们正确的答案。

examples.text_en: We can concatenate these two words into one.
examples.text_zh: 我们可以把这两个词连成一个。

examples.text_en: The program will concatenate the files in a row.
examples.text_zh: 程序会把这些文件依次连接起来。

examples.text_en: The small mirror had a concave face.
examples.text_zh: 这面小镜子有一个凹面。

examples.text_en: A concave shape can hold the water well.
examples.text_zh: 凹形能很好地盛住水。

examples.text_en: His concentration on the book was broken by noise.
examples.text_zh: 他对书本的专注被噪音打断了。

examples.text_en: She needs full concentration to solve this hard problem.
examples.text_zh: 她需要全神贯注才能解决这道难题。

examples.text_en: The two circles are concentric on the page.
examples.text_zh: 这两个圆在同一页上同心。

examples.text_en: A target has many concentric rings.
examples.text_zh: 靶子上有许多同心圆环。

examples.text_en: His conception of the plan was quite simple.
examples.text_zh: 他对这个计划的构想相当简单。

examples.text_en: The book changed my conception of time.
examples.text_zh: 这本书改变了我对时间的观念。

examples.text_en: The plan was only a conceptual one at first.
examples.text_zh: 这个计划起初只是一个概念性的方案。

examples.text_en: We need a conceptual model before we build.
examples.text_zh: 在动工之前我们需要一个概念模型。

examples.text_en: The team made a concerted effort to win.
examples.text_zh: 全队齐心协力去争取胜利。

examples.text_en: They took concerted action to solve the problem.
examples.text_zh: 他们采取一致行动来解决这个问题。

examples.text_en: The young woman played a long concerto last night.
examples.text_zh: 昨晚那位年轻女子演奏了一首长长的协奏曲。

examples.text_en: This concerto is hard and takes much practice.
examples.text_zh: 这首协奏曲很难，需要大量练习。

examples.text_en: The two sides made a concession to end the talk.
examples.text_zh: 双方各让一步，结束了会谈。

examples.text_en: He got a concession on the price of the car.
examples.text_zh: 他在那辆车的价格上得到了让步。

examples.text_en: The company made several concessions to the workers.
examples.text_zh: 公司向工人们作出了几项让步。

examples.text_en: Small concessions can keep the peace between them.
examples.text_zh: 小小的让步能让双方保持和睦。

examples.text_en: She tried to conciliate the two angry men.
examples.text_zh: 她试着安抚这两个生气的人。

examples.text_en: A kind word can conciliate a hard heart.
examples.text_zh: 一句好话能安抚一颗冷酷的心。

examples.text_en: He made a conciliatory move to end the fight.
examples.text_zh: 他作出了和解的举动以结束争斗。

examples.text_en: Her conciliatory words helped both sides agree.
examples.text_zh: 她那些和好的话帮助双方达成了一致。

examples.text_en: The conciseness of the note made it easy to read.
examples.text_zh: 这张便条简洁明了，读起来很容易。

examples.text_en: He values conciseness in both speech and writing.
examples.text_zh: 他重视说话和写作中的简洁。

examples.text_en: The cardinals held a conclave in the chapel.
examples.text_zh: 红衣主教们在礼拜堂举行了秘密会议。

examples.text_en: A small conclave decided the future of the group.
examples.text_zh: 一个小型秘密会议决定了团体的未来。

examples.text_en: The evidence was conclusive and ended the case.
examples.text_zh: 证据是确凿的，结束了这桩案子。

examples.text_en: We need conclusive proof before we decide.
examples.text_zh: 在做出决定之前，我们需要确凿的证据。

examples.text_en: He tried to concoct a story to save himself.
examples.text_zh: 他试图编造一个故事来为自己开脱。

examples.text_en: She can concoct a good meal from a few things.
examples.text_zh: 她能用几样东西调配出一顿好饭。

examples.text_en: The new law had concomitant effects on the market.
examples.text_zh: 这项新法律对市场产生了伴随而来的影响。

examples.text_en: Hard work and success are often concomitant.
examples.text_zh: 努力和成功常常相伴而行。

examples.text_en: The two countries lived in peace and concord.
examples.text_zh: 两国和睦相处，彼此一致。

examples.text_en: There was full concord between the two sides.
examples.text_zh: 双方之间完全一致。

examples.text_en: We cannot concur with that view.
examples.text_zh: 我们不能同意那种看法。

examples.text_en: Many people concur with the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 许多人都同意这项新计划。

examples.text_en: There was general concurrence on the new plan.
examples.text_zh: 大家对这项新计划普遍表示赞同。

examples.text_en: The concurrence of the two events was a surprise.
examples.text_zh: 这两件事同时发生，令人惊讶。

examples.text_en: The two events were concurrent last spring.
examples.text_zh: 这两件事去年春天同时发生。

examples.text_en: Concurrent meetings made the day quite busy.
examples.text_zh: 同时举行的几个会议让这一天很忙。

examples.text_en: The fall gave him a bad concussion.
examples.text_zh: 这一摔使他出现了严重的脑震荡。

examples.text_en: The concussion left her in bed for a week.
examples.text_zh: 那次脑震荡让她卧床一周。

examples.text_en: The plan met with strong condemnation from all sides.
examples.text_zh: 这项计划遭到了各方的强烈谴责。

examples.text_en: His condemnation of the act was clear and firm.
examples.text_zh: 他对这一行为的谴责明确而坚定。

examples.text_en: The condensation on the glass was cold and wet.
examples.text_zh: 玻璃上的冷凝水又冷又湿。

examples.text_en: You can see the condensation of the water at night.
examples.text_zh: 夜里你能看到水的凝结。

examples.text_en: You can condense the long story into a few words.
examples.text_zh: 你可以把这个长故事压缩成几句话。

examples.text_en: Cold air can condense the water in the room.
examples.text_zh: 冷空气能使房间里的水汽凝结。

examples.text_en: The condenser turns hot steam into water.
examples.text_zh: 冷凝器把热蒸汽变成水。

examples.text_en: A broken condenser caused the machine to stop.
examples.text_zh: 冷凝器损坏导致机器停止运转。

examples.text_en: He did not condescend to speak to the workers.
examples.text_zh: 他不屑于和工人们说话。

examples.text_en: Please do not condescend to those who need help.
examples.text_zh: 请不要对那些需要帮助的人摆出屈尊的姿态。

examples.text_en: He got the condign punishment for his act.
examples.text_zh: 他因自己的行为受到了应得的惩罚。

examples.text_en: A condign reward was given to the brave man.
examples.text_zh: 这位勇敢的人得到了应有的奖赏。

examples.text_en: We went to condole with her after the death.
examples.text_zh: 她亲人去世后，我们去向她表示慰问。

examples.text_en: They came to condole with the family in person.
examples.text_zh: 他们亲自前来向这家人表示吊唁。

examples.text_en: He sent a letter of condolence to the family.
examples.text_zh: 他给这家人寄去了一封慰问信。

examples.text_en: Please accept my deep condolence for your loss.
examples.text_zh: 请接受我对你失去亲人表示的深切哀悼。

examples.text_en: A condor can fly high above the great mountains.
examples.text_zh: 神鹰能高高飞越巍峨的群山。

examples.text_en: The condor is a very large bird.
examples.text_zh: 神鹰是一种非常大的鸟。

examples.text_en: Fresh air is conducive to good health.
examples.text_zh: 新鲜空气有益于健康。

examples.text_en: A quiet room is conducive to hard study.
examples.text_zh: 安静的房间有助于专心学习。

examples.text_en: The conductivity of this metal is very high.
examples.text_zh: 这种金属的导电率非常高。

examples.text_en: Water can change the conductivity of the soil.
examples.text_zh: 水能改变土壤的传导性。

examples.text_en: The conductor raised his hands and the music began.
examples.text_zh: 指挥举起双手，音乐开始了。

examples.text_en: The conductor took our cards on the train.
examples.text_zh: 售票员在火车上收了我们的票卡。

examples.text_en: Water flows through a long metal conduit.
examples.text_zh: 水通过一根长长的金属导管流动。

examples.text_en: They buried the conduit under the garden path.
examples.text_zh: 他们把导管埋在花园的小径下。

examples.text_en: The shop sells every kind of confection.
examples.text_zh: 这家店出售各种糖果。

examples.text_en: She made a sweet confection for the children.
examples.text_zh: 她给孩子们做了一种甜甜的蜜饯。

examples.text_en: The small states formed a loose confederacy.
examples.text_zh: 这些小邦组成了一个松散的联盟。

examples.text_en: The confederacy of tribes shared one leader.
examples.text_zh: 各部落组成的联盟共推一位首领。

examples.text_en: He found a loyal confederate in the town.
examples.text_zh: 他在镇上找到了一个忠诚的同盟者。

examples.text_en: The two confederate groups planned a joint effort.
examples.text_zh: 这两个同盟团体筹划了一次联合行动。

examples.text_en: The king will confer a title on the brave man.
examples.text_zh: 国王将授予这位勇敢的人一个头衔。

examples.text_en: They will confer about the plan in the morning.
examples.text_zh: 他们将在早上商议这项计划。

examples.text_en: He was her closest confidant for many years.
examples.text_zh: 多年来他都是她最亲近的知己。

examples.text_en: A true confidant will keep every secret safe.
examples.text_zh: 一个真正的知己会守住每一个秘密。

examples.text_en: This letter is confidential and for your eyes only.
examples.text_zh: 这封信是机密，只供你本人阅看。

examples.text_en: Please keep this news confidential for now.
examples.text_zh: 请暂时对这个消息保密。

examples.text_en: The new configuration made the system run faster.
examples.text_zh: 新的配置让系统运行得更快。

examples.text_en: She changed the configuration of the small room.
examples.text_zh: 她改变了这个小房间的布局。

examples.text_en: His confinement to the house lasted many long weeks.
examples.text_zh: 他被禁闭在家，持续了许多个漫长的星期。

examples.text_en: The doctor ordered the confinement of the sick man.
examples.text_zh: 医生下令把病人隔离起来。

examples.text_en: The confining room made him feel restless.
examples.text_zh: 狭小的房间让他感到烦躁不安。

examples.text_en: She disliked the confining rules of the school.
examples.text_zh: 她不喜欢学校那些约束人的规定。

examples.text_en: The conflagration destroyed several houses in town.
examples.text_zh: 这场大火烧毁了镇上的好几栋房子。

examples.text_en: Firefighters battled the conflagration through the night.
examples.text_zh: 消防员奋战了一整夜扑救大火。

examples.text_en: Do not conflate these two very different ideas.
examples.text_zh: 不要把这两个很不一样的想法混为一谈。

examples.text_en: People often conflate the two words in daily talk.
examples.text_zh: 人们常在日常交谈中把这两个词混在一起。

examples.text_en: We got conflicting news about the same event.
examples.text_zh: 关于同一件事，我们得到了互相矛盾的消息。

examples.text_en: Their conflicting views made the talk difficult.
examples.text_zh: 他们相互冲突的看法使谈话变得困难。

examples.text_en: The town grew at the confluence of two rivers.
examples.text_zh: 这座城镇在两条河的汇合处发展起来。

examples.text_en: There was a confluence of people at the gate.
examples.text_zh: 人群在门口汇聚在一起。

examples.text_en: A conformist will follow the group and not ask why.
examples.text_zh: 墨守成规的人会跟随大众，而不问为什么。

examples.text_en: He was a conformist and never broke a rule.
examples.text_zh: 他是个循规蹈矩的人，从不违反规定。

examples.text_en: His strange answer seemed to confound us all.
examples.text_zh: 他奇怪的回答似乎让我们全都困惑了。

examples.text_en: The results confound what we expected to find.
examples.text_zh: 这些结果让我们预期的发现变得扑朔迷离。

examples.text_en: The cold air made the oil congeal in the pan.
examples.text_zh: 冷空气使锅里的油凝结了。

examples.text_en: Blood will congeal when it meets the cold air.
examples.text_zh: 血遇到冷空气就会凝固。

examples.text_en: The small group was congenial and easy to join.
examples.text_zh: 这个小团体很合得来，很容易加入。

examples.text_en: His congenial ways made him popular in the office.
examples.text_zh: 他为人和善，在办公室里很受欢迎。

examples.text_en: Too many cars congest the narrow town road.
examples.text_zh: 太多汽车让这条狭窄的镇路拥堵不堪。

examples.text_en: Heavy traffic can congest the city streets.
examples.text_zh: 繁忙的交通会造成城市街道拥堵。

examples.text_en: The congestion on the road made us late.
examples.text_zh: 路上的拥堵让我们迟到了。

examples.text_en: City congestion is a problem for every big town.
examples.text_zh: 城市拥堵是每个大城市都面临的问题。

examples.text_en: He sent her a warm congratulation on the new job.
examples.text_zh: 他就她的新工作向她致以热烈的祝贺。

examples.text_en: A short congratulation can make a person happy.
examples.text_zh: 一句简短的祝贺能让人开心。

examples.text_en: The children will congregate in the small park.
examples.text_zh: 孩子们会在小公园里聚集。

examples.text_en: Small birds congregate near the water at night.
examples.text_zh: 小鸟在夜里聚集在水边。

examples.text_en: The congressman gave a long talk to the crowd.
examples.text_zh: 这位国会议员对人群作了长时间的讲话。

examples.text_en: A young congressman asked for a change in the law.
examples.text_zh: 一位年轻的国会议员要求修改这项法律。

examples.text_en: The two shapes are congruent in size and form.
examples.text_zh: 这两个图形在大小和形状上完全一致。

examples.text_en: His words were congruent with the facts.
examples.text_zh: 他的话与事实相符。

examples.text_en: There is a clear congruity between the two plans.
examples.text_zh: 这两个计划之间有明显的一致性。

examples.text_en: The congruity of their views helped the talk.
examples.text_zh: 他们看法一致，使谈话很顺利。
